messages.subject: [VOTE] Release Airflow 3.2.0 from 3.2.0rc2 & Task SDK 1.2.0 from 1.2.0rc2
messages.body:
Hey fellow Airflowers,

The release candidates for Apache Airflow 3.2.0rc2 and Task SDK 1.2.0rc2
are now available for testing!

This email is calling for a vote on the release, which will last at least
until *07th Apr* and until 3 binding +1 votes have been received.

Consider this my +1 binding vote.

Airflow 3.2.0rc2 is available at:
https://dist.apache.org/repos/dist/dev/airflow/3.2.0rc2/

"apache-airflow" Meta package:
- *apache-airflow-3.2.0-source.tar.gz* is a source release that comes with
INSTALL instructions.
- *apache-airflow-3.2.0.tar.gz* is the binary Python "sdist" release.
- *apache_airflow-3.2.0-py3-none-any.whl* is the binary Python wheel
"binary" release.

"apache-airflow-core" package:
- *apache_airflow_core-3.2.0.tar.gz* is the binary Python "sdist" release.
- *apache_airflow_core-3.2.0-py3-none-any.whl* is the binary Python wheel
"binary" release.

Task SDK 1.2.0 is available at:
https://dist.apache.org/repos/dist/dev/airflow/task-sdk/1.2.0rc2/

"apache-airflow-task-sdk" package:
- *apache_airflow_task_sdk-1.2.0.tar.gz* is the binary Python "sdist"
release.
- *apache_airflow_task_sdk-1.2.0-py3-none-any.whl* is the binary Python
wheel "binary" release.

Public keys are available at:
https://dist.apache.org/repos/dist/release/airflow/KEYS

Please vote accordingly:

[ ] +1 approve
[ ] +0 no opinion
[ ] -1 disapprove with the reason

Only votes from PMC members are binding, but all members of the community
are encouraged to test the release and vote with "(non-binding)".

The test procedure for PMC members is described in:
https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/dev/README_RELEASE_AIRFLOW.md\#verify-the-release-candidate-by-pmc-members

The test procedure for contributors and members of the community who would
like to test this RC is described in:
https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/dev/README_RELEASE_AIRFLOW.md\#verify-the-release-candidate-by-contributors

Please note that the version number excludes the 'rcX' string, so it's now
simply 3.2.0 for Airflow package and 1.2.0 for Task SDK. This will allow us
to rename the artifact without modifying
the artifact checksums when we actually release.

Docs (for preview):
https://airflow.staged.apache.org/docs/apache-airflow/3.2.0

Release Notes:
- https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/3.2.0rc2/RELEASE_NOTES.rst
- https://airflow.staged.apache.org/docs/apache-airflow/3.2
.0/release_notes.html
(Rendered HTML)

Testing Instructions using PyPI:
You can build a virtualenv that installs this and other required packages
(e.g. task sdk), like this:

uv venv
uv pip install -U \
  apache-airflow==3.2.0rc2 \
  apache-airflow-core==3.2.0rc2 \
  apache-airflow-task-sdk==1.2.0rc2

Constraints files are at
https://github.com/apache/airflow/tree/constraints-3.2.0rc2

Regards,
Rahul Vats

Thanks for the RC2, Rahul!

Airflow/Airflow Core: +1 (binding), checked:

  - Signatures

Task SDK: +1 (binding), checked:

Note: This is a technical check (only) as of now. As of easter time I am 
in parallel not able to test all and everything. Basic checks are OK 
(testing plain vanilla setup via breeze with EdgeExecutor and 
Integration Test Dag).

find real problems I'll post it here, until then I see it as working.

messages.subject: Re: [VOTE] Release Airflow 3.2.0 from 3.2.0rc2 & Task SDK 1.2.0 from 1.2.0rc2
messages.body:
Thanks Rahul.

+1 binding on Airflow Core and TaskSDK.

I tested the 3.2.0rc2 with some of the example DAGs and some of my DAGs
built with common.sql and an early version of common.ai.
I tested both with airflow standalone and with local executor.

I ran into some issues, but Pavan determined that those were issues those
specific providers and not with Airflow core.
After a configuration change, based on his recommendation, my DAGs ran
fine.

Vikram
